messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "more likely on longer courses"
set: ["more likely on longer courses", "effect seen on longer courses", "more likely at higher doses", "more likely after long-term use", "more likely in severe cirrhosis", "more likely with rapid fluid loss", "more likely at 0.8 mg dose", "more likely in people with depression", "more likely in people with mental illness", "more likely in people with bipolar disorder", "higher risk of fractures more likely after menopause", "lasts longer", "older adults more likely to build up high potassium level", "more likely to cause problems if your potassium is low", "serotonin syndrome is more likely when taken with other serotonergic medications", "improvement takes longer"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
